company.name: Turquoise
company.shortDescription: Turquoise provides a transaction efficiency platform utilized by healthcare organizations to streamline payment processes.
company.description: Turquoise Health offers a platform that aggregates and standardizes hospital pricing data, including negotiated rates, to support analysis and comparison across providers and payers. It provides tools that help organizations manage compliance with transparency regulations and interpret large datasets related to healthcare costs. Turquoise Health also offers APIs and dashboards that integrate pricing data into operational and analytical systems used by payers, providers, and researchers. The company supports use cases such as benchmarking, contract analysis, and cost estimation within healthcare ecosystems.
